rule.query: query selected { match "architecture.batch-work-queue.drain"(unit: $unit, queue: $queue, register: $register, input: $input, consume: $consume, iteration: $iteration, item: $item, dispatch: $dispatch, reset: $reset); emit $unit, $queue, $register, $input, $consume, $iteration, $item, $dispatch, $reset; }
rule.name: architecture.batch-work-queue.drain

review.claim: Concrete commands retain services/data and their execute methods invoke service work. TaskScheduler stores Command input, invokes execute on each unchanged iteration element (await inside try), then resets tasks to a fresh empty array. Static source inspection only; no exactly-once or successful execution guarantee.

timing.note: Engine-only queries on prebuilt index/registry. View construction separate. Excludes parse/link, disk cache, CLI. p95 nearest rank describes sample only. Requests source manifest in ir130-requests.json.
